sloka: मनसा प्रहसामि त्वां देवि दुःखार्धिता सती ।यच्छोचितव्ये हृष्टासि प्राप्येदं व्यसनं महत् ॥२-८-३॥
transliteration: manasā prahasāmi tvāṁ devi duḥkhārdhitā satī ।yacchocitavye hṛṣṭāsi prāpyedaṁ vyasanaṁ mahat ॥2-8-3॥

translations.english: O queen at a time when this great misfortune has befallen you, you are rejoicing instead of feeling miserable. I am indeed laughing at you at heart.
